AkkLove LAOS4-16 (X001013) – translation (Wasserman 2016)

Web: https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/akklove/X001013/html

Project translation extracted from the ORACC HTML view (rank 3 in our hierarchy; consult only after our own reading).
Each paragraph: [first label – last label of the transliteration lines it translates] text. "## " = section heading.

[o i 1](He:) Yell! Do not bother to reply! [o i 2]Not so much talking! [o i 3]My decision is made, [o i 4]I will not change for you a word, anything I said.[o i 6] He who lies on his back for a woman is a weevil from the city wall.[o i 8]If he is not serious he is no match for a man. [o i 9](She:) May my righteousness appear before Ištar the queen![o i 11] May my love prevail, may my slanderer come to shame!
[o i 13] At Nanāya’s command I have always (taken upon me) to adore you, to charm you, to take care of (my) baby![o i 16]Where is my match?! [o i 17](He:) I remember more than you your tricks of the past.[o i 19] Give up! Go away! Report to your counselor that we are (now) awake!
[o i 22] (She:) I will catch you, and this very day I shall reconcile your love with mine.[o i 24]I keep on praying to Nanāya; [o i 25](So that) I shall accept your peace, my lord, forever, as a gift.[o i 27](He:) I shall lay siege upon you, [o i 28]I shall gather my clouds on you. [o i 29]May your supporter take away your seductiveness, put an end to your complaint![o i 31]Accept the truth! [o i 32]...[o ii 1](He:) [...] she/he was aw[ake(?)] [o ii 2]and does not exist. [o ii 3]Nothing is in my heart ... will be paid out to her.[o ii 5]I yearn for my [lo]ve. [o ii 6](She:) May queen Ištar [pour] confusion over the one who loves you not![o ii 8]May she, like me, [be afflicted] with sleeplessness! [o ii 9]May she be dazed and [restless] all night long! [o ii 10](He:) I despise the girl who does not wo[rship (me)]. [o ii 11]I do not desire for the girl who does not [fawn]. [o ii 12]I shall not give her [my love-charm]. [o ii 13]Talking in order to dis[agree] [o ii 14]Why [does it exist?] [o ii 15]I shall stop [her/my] slanderers, [o ii 16]I shall not hear what [...] [o ii 17]To the m[idst of darkness] I have thrown away my love:[o ii 19]Why do you keep bothering [me]? [o ii 20](She:) My (ominous) signs trouble me: [o ii 21]My upper lip becomes moist, [o ii 22]While my lower lip trembles! [o ii 23]I shall embrace him, I shall kiss him, [o ii 24]I shall gaze at [him], [o ii 25]I shall achieve my victory [...] over [my slanderers],[o ii 27]And to my lover [I shall] gracefully [...] [o ii 28]When our sleep [...] [o ii 29]We shall achieve [victory] [o ii 30]...[r iii 1](She:) ... [r iii 2]In [...] [r iii 3][My(?)] gazelle [...] [r iii 4]I run but I cannot [reach him], [r iii 5]She gave him to Ištar as a gift. [r iii 6](He:) As for those (women) who keep telling you: [r iii 7]“Y[ou] are not the only one!” [r iii 8]Stop! I have taken my love away, and will not [return (it)]. [r iii 9]I have removed [it] from your body, [r iii 10]I have taken my charms thousands of miles away. [r iii 11](She:) I seek [your] pleasures, [r iii 12]My lord, I yearn for [your] love. [r iii 13]Because in your delights [...] [r iii 14]Let them be veiled, would they never [...] [r iii 15]I shall talk [to you] day and night. [r iii 16](He:) Let me repeat it twice and thrice; [r iii 17]I swear not to say anything kind to you (lit. satisfy my mouth with kindness), [r iii 18]Take your place by the window orifice: [r iii 19]Come on, catch my love! [r iii 20](She:) My eyes are very tired, [r iii 21]I am sleepless from gazing at him, [r iii 22]It seems that he walked across my street? [r iii 23]The day has gone by, where is [my darling (or: my lord)]?[r iv 1](She:) To catch him [...] [r iv 2]The one [...] [r iv 3]What [...] [r iv 4]Come on, let me hold [his] k[nees], [r iv 5]I shall sit and wait maby he is on his way to me! [r iv 6](He:) I have sworn to you by Nanāya and Hammurāpi the king; [r iv 7]Indeed, I am telling to you the truth; [r iv 8]Your love is nothing more to me than agony and grief.[r iv 10](She:) They(f.) ... because I trust my loved one. [r iv 11]My slanderers outnumber the stars of heaven.[r iv 13]May they hide! May they be scarce! [r iv 14]May they hide themselves forever right now! [r iv 15]And as for me, I sat down, listening to the words of my lord.[r iv 17] (He:) My one, not ugly are your features – (they are) as before,[r iv 19](When) I stood by you, [r iv 20]And you leaned your sh[oulders] (against me). [r iv 21][Mag]irtum (“Favorable”) is your name, [r iv 22]“Wise la[dy]” – your title. [r iv 23]The other woman is indeed our misfortune, [r iv 24]By Ištar! [r iv 25][...Nice]ly you reply.
